dedupe_keys.name: data from energy meters of the nanogune building spain

description: Andoni Anero and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The San Sebastian collection contains 79 meters: 58 electrical, twenty thermal and one gas meter. Thermal meters comprise ten heating and ten cooling meters. Measurements distinguish intensive equipment such as chillers, laboratories and the clean room from offices, lighting and other installations. The stated five-month coverage has fifteen-minute readings, CSV time series and JSON metadata. BEMServer supplies the BMS export. These are physical building-energy inputs for consumption analysis and performance models; the description does not specify the exact five-month dates. ENERIT management outputs may aggregate related measurements, so that separate derived resource is not treated as an independent measurement campaign. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cdla-permissive-1.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
